title: Ofcom Broadcasting Code Section Three - Crime, Disorder, Hatred and Abuse
expect: abusive or derogatory treatment of individuals
notes: IN SCOPE via the context route, not the watershed. Rules 3.2/3.3 are permitted 'except where it is justified by the context', and context is Section Two's defined term whose third factor is the time of broadcast. Added 2026-11-06 after the 'significant numbers of children' test was shown to be too narrow (see C-11).

title: Ofcom Broadcasting Code, Section Four: Religion
notes: AUTHORITATIVE FORM. The only maintained version - Ofcom no longer publishes the Code in print, so there is no current consolidated PDF. UK-S0 is the Jan 2019 print edition and does NOT contain this text. In scope for ONE rule only: Rule 4.7, which bars claims that a living person has special powers when significant numbers of children may be expected to be watching. That is a child-audience broadcast restriction outside Section One. The rest of Section Four (religious content standards) is out of scope.
